newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Cash up in line with MGE.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Cash up in line with MGE.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash prices were mostly marked up in line with gains in MGE futures on Tuesday in very quiet conditions.
"We're up with the futures. The basis is unchanged," one Minnesota based dealer said.
March MGE spring wheat futures ended up two cents a bushel at $3.78-1/2.
Dealers said trade had slowed down after fairly active business last week. They also noted the weather had warmed up in many parts of the spring wheat belt with bright sunshine reported in Montana.
White wheat prices edged slightly higher. Trade was also very subdued with farmer selling at a virtual standstill.
"They (farmers) have seen these prices before and are not going to give up now," one white wheat dealer said.
